name: Algebraic Identity Obfuscation via Dummy Coefficients
description: Replaces the recognizable independent-set Laplacian quadratic form with a system-load equation (ACL == ECL) that assigns arbitrary-looking weights to edges based on subset membership. The equation algebraically simplifies to `4 * (edges within panel) == 0`. Models that fail to manually perform this algebraic simplification will implement a naive black-box search and TLE, missing the independent-set graph pruning heuristics.
